_comment: SAMPLE ONLY. Not the format of any particular EHR: Epic, Oracle Health and Meditech each have their own registration form or API (see smart-on-fhir.md). Use this as the list of facts you will be asked for. Replace every placeholder.
client_id: <assigned by the EHR vendor, put it in NEXT_PUBLIC_SMART_CLIENT_ID>
policy_uri: <privacy policy URL; it needs wording for this use>
intended_use: Calculation and reference aid for qualified clinicians (DRAFT wording, pending legal and regulatory review). Reads age, sex and recent results in the browser; nothing from the record is sent to Clinexia servers.
notes: launch_uri: add ?calc=<calculator id> to choose the calculator (default egfr-ckd-epi) and &embed=1 to open the embedded view; the EHR appends iss and launch.
Only calculators with FHIR-coded inputs and outside the dosing and oncology categories can be launched.
